units.source_text: 在箱根，我曾听秀哉名人谈论过他的中国之行。

en.t: At Hakone, I once heard Master Shusai talk about his trip to China.

units.source_text: 主要是谈他在哪里同谁下了几目的事。

en.t: He mainly spoke about where he had played, whom he had played against, and by how many points.

units.source_text: 我想中国的围棋也相当强，便问道：

en.t: Thinking that Chinese go must also be quite strong, I asked:
